QuestInfo.name: [Phantom Forest] The Ravens' Rest
QuestInfo.0: As you prove what your capable of, the man who seems to be the leader of the thieves changes his attitude. Listen to his story.
QuestInfo.1: The group that seemed to be thieves actually turns out to be the Raven Ninja, friends of Corine and descendants of the Shadowknights. They say they came here e to repay the debt of their ancestors, so give them a hand and defeat Elderwraiths.
QuestInfo.2: You helped the Raven Ninja by defeating Elderwraiths.

mob.0: The spirits haunting this forest are the souls of warriors who died in the great war a thousand years ago. I'd like you to defeat them and bring back the ashes they leave behind. With those in hand, I'd like to hold a funeral to put these noble spirits to rest at last.
